bio: Kimoku was once the best thief in the Broken Reach – and, technically, she still is. She stole a Demon Lord’s prize weapon, only to discover that it held his soul. Now her every waking moment is spent evading his hunters… which would be easier if she didn’t keep stopping to mock them.
